name: Taimashi to Mahou Shoujo (3) ~Kodomo no Rei to Inari no Musume~
original_name: 退魔士と魔法少女(3)～子供の霊と稲荷の娘～
source:
One month ago, exorcist Kaoru Okumoto was hired to investigate the nature of a major spiritual force in their hometown, during which Kaoru and childhood friend Serika Suno met a fellow older exorcist named Haruka Hatayama.

Petite death goddess "Mei" helped the exorcists deal with the spirit force. Some days later, a young girl called "Karen" appeared to Kaoru. With a smile and a lisp Karen looked at Kaoru and said...

"Father."

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ190094.html]DLsite English[/url]]
